# Property Source Exchange — Official Platform Reference

Last updated: October 13, 2026
Canonical website: https://propertysource.app/
Registration: https://app.propertysource.app/register
Owner and operator: Property Hub Exchange, Inc.

Official contact: 8 The Green, Suite A, Dover, Delaware 19901; telephone 941-207-2090; email platform@propertysource.app.

## What Property Source Exchange is

Property Source Exchange is a global real estate exchange platform that connects hundreds of independent real estate marketplaces, communities, brokerages, lenders, investors, and professional networks. Each participating organization keeps its identity and branded marketplace while gaining access to shared global property inventory, transaction infrastructure, lenders, title companies, and essential services.

Organizations may launch a free turnkey white-label marketplace or connect an existing marketplace through a two-way API. A turnkey marketplace can use the organization’s logo, colors, custom domain, and branded registration experience. Marketplace owners pay no setup fee and no monthly platform fee.

## Network facts displayed by the official website

- 480 connected marketplaces
- 14,000 integrated title companies
- 21 integrated lenders

These network counts may change as the platform grows.

## Strategic platform partners

Strategic partners displayed on the official website include Alpha Funding, Anchor Loans, Axe Capital, Brick City Capital, Center Street Lending, Colonial Funding Group, Conventus, CoreVest Finance, CV3 Financial Services, D1 Funds, Easy Street Capital, Kiavi, Peak Private Lending, Private Money Lenders, RCN Capital, Residential Capital Partners, SimpleBridge, Sky Equity, and Velocity Lending.

## AI Powered Exchange

### The network is the power. AI is the multiplier.

A global network of buyers and sellers. An intelligent operating layer that never sleeps.

Property Hub Exchange puts AI to work across Property Source Exchange—from recruiting marketplace partners and sourcing property opportunities to member support, analysis, and transaction coordination. The real strength is the people and opportunities in the network. AI orchestrates the information, reduces friction, and helps buyers and sellers move forward across connected marketplaces worldwide.

### Growth that never sleeps.

**Recruit & connect** — Conversational AI agents reach marketplace partners, property owners, and wholesalers—helping bring new communities and property deals into the exchange.

### Answers in every channel.

**Chat • Voice • Phone** — From text chat and live on-platform voice conversations to phone support, AI agents guide members through navigation, technical questions, and the next step.

### Intelligence behind every deal.

**Analyze & inform** — AI helps analyze properties, lenders, and relevant information—organizing complex data into useful insights that support more informed decisions.

### An always-on operating layer.

**Orchestrate & streamline** — AI agents take on routine outreach, support, and coordination duties, creating a scalable 24/7 digital workforce that helps streamline transactions worldwide.

### Your investors bring their AI. We connect the opportunity.

The exchange is designed to help investor-operated AI agents discover and work with property deals through connected, machine-readable interfaces. AI inside the platform and agents outside it can support a more connected real estate ecosystem.

External-agent access depends on the supported integration and its permissions.

## Marketplace and network capabilities

- Turnkey white-label marketplace with custom domain, logo, colors, and registration
- Two-way API connection for an existing website or marketplace
- Aggregated listings shared across connected independent marketplaces
- Single sign-on for a global view of available deals
- Residential, multifamily, commercial, industrial, land, and mortgage-note assets
- Individual property listing and bulk CSV or XML uploads
- Map, satellite, Street View, and address-assisted property search
- AI-assisted U.S. property research through text or voice questions
- Blind-sale privacy that protects buyer and seller identities until signing
- Email and text notifications for matching property opportunities

## Digital transaction and closing capabilities

- Digital offer generation, submission, negotiation, acceptance, and rejection
- Contract generation and electronic signatures
- Automated transaction engine covering documents, closing, and post-closing workflows
- Delivery of accepted transaction information and documents into title-company workflows
- Online earnest-money deposits to title-company escrow accounts
- Real-time closing milestone tracking
- Integrated lenders, title companies, inspection providers, surveyors, insurance providers, attorneys, and other transaction resources
- Online property auctions with marketplace-controlled pricing and duration

## Marketplace-owner operations

Marketplace owners receive an administrative dashboard for members, activity, listings, transactions, settings, reports, revenue, and payment visibility. Owners can send branded email and SMS alerts, campaigns, announcements, and invitations. Owners may promote their own lending services or select providers from the integrated lender network.

## Revenue-share model

### Free to launch. Free to connect.

Investor communities and brokerage networks can connect an existing branded marketplace or create one with the turnkey templates. There are no setup fees, monthly platform fees, or out-of-pocket platform costs. Property Source Exchange provides and manages the technology; marketplace owners grow their communities.

### Every marketplace can host both buyers and sellers.

| Member’s role | Technology fee | Share | Revenue-share recipient |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Seller lists and sells a property | $500 | 20% = $100 | Owner of the independent marketplace hosting the seller |
| Buyer purchases that property | $1,500 | 20% = $300 | Owner of the independent marketplace hosting the buyer |

Every independent marketplace can host both buyers and sellers; these are transaction roles, not marketplace types. The share follows the member. If the same marketplace hosts both the seller and buyer of a completed sale, its owner receives both shares: $100 + $300 = $400. A seller’s property can be bought by a member of any connected marketplace. In a cross-marketplace sale, Marketplace A (hosting the seller) earns $100 and Marketplace B (hosting the buyer) earns $300. Neither marketplace receives both shares merely because it hosts the listing. Shares arise from completed transactions, not simply listing or making an offer. The percentages apply to technology fees, not property sale prices. The seller technology fee is paid at settlement and disbursed by the title company.

### Ambassador program — 5%

Earn an ongoing 5% ambassador share from transaction activity generated by each new independent marketplace you refer to the exchange.

### Free built-in banner advertising

Each independent marketplace includes a free banner advertising system. Its owner may post unlimited ads for vendors, services, affiliates, or other promotions of their choice. The ads are displayed to that specific marketplace’s members, not across all independent marketplaces. Owners manage placements through their owner dashboard and retain full control and 100% of their own advertising and affiliate revenue, with no platform advertising fee or advertising revenue share.

### Evergreen, not a one-time reward

Transaction and ambassador revenue shares continue while the relevant marketplaces remain active and transacting. Transactions and revenue shares are tracked by the platform and visible in the marketplace-owner dashboard.

## Intended marketplace partners

The platform is designed for real estate community owners, network owners, lenders with borrower networks, third-party loan brokers with investor networks, real estate brokerages with agent networks, real estate influencers, educators with followers or students, asset managers, and other real estate groups seeking access to a global exchange.
